Privacy, Terms & Disclosures

Bet This Guy is an independent sports-research and entertainment product. It is not a sportsbook, does not accept wagers, and does not guarantee any outcome.

Privacy

You may browse Bet This Guy without creating an account. If you register, we process your email address, optional display name, saved settings, saved props, tracked picks, wager amounts, odds, results and account timestamps so those features can sync across your devices.

Authentication is provided by Supabase. Bet This Guy does not receive or store your password. Google and Apple may process information under their own privacy policies if you use those sign-in options.

Our hosting, authentication and sports-data providers may process ordinary technical information needed to deliver and secure the service, such as IP address, browser information, request time and requested page. Live odds and statistics are supplied by third-party data services.

Site statistics

To see which parts of the site are used, we count page views and a few actions (such as adding a pick to the bet slip or sharing it) as anonymous daily totals. No cookies, IP addresses or personal identifiers are stored for this. A “visited before” flag stays in your own browser so we can tell new visits from returning ones, and we count which kind of site a visit came from (for example Reddit, X or Google, or typed in directly), never the full web address.

Partner links

If we show a partner link (for example to a fantasy or sportsbook app), we use the approximate state your connection comes from, as provided by our host at the time of the request, only to show offers where they are legal. It is not stored. We may earn a commission if you sign up through a partner link.

Pick alerts

  • Phone and browser alerts: we store the push address your browser gives us (it does not identify you) and the sportsbooks you picked in Settings, if any, so we can notify you when a new official pick posts or one of your sportsbooks has a good-value price. Turning alerts off deletes them.
  • Email alerts: we use your account email and the sportsbooks saved in your settings to tell you when new official picks post or one of your sportsbooks has a good-value price. Emails are sent through our email provider (Resend), and every one has a one-click unsubscribe link. You can also turn them off in your account.

What we don’t do

We do not sell personal information. Account data is used only to provide saved settings, personal tracking and security. Device-local data may remain in your browser until you clear it or import it into an account.

Terms of use

  • You must be at least 21, or the legal gambling age where you live, to use betting-related features.
  • The product is for information and entertainment. Nothing displayed is financial advice, a guarantee or a promise of profit.
  • Odds can change, suspend, or be incorrect. Verify every market, price and restriction directly with a licensed operator before acting.
  • You are responsible for following the laws where you are located and for using only lawful, licensed services.
  • Bet This Guy may change, suspend or remove features and may correct inaccurate information at any time.

Accuracy and methodology

“Verified market” means a fresh market supported by the connected multi-book odds feed. It does not mean the recommendation is guaranteed, independently audited, or profitable. Market edge is an estimate compared with a no-vig market baseline. Results are recorded separately for individual props and parlays, and a meaningful sample is required before performance claims are made.

Player history is supplied by BALLDONTLIE and filtered to regular-season and postseason games for NFL profiles. First-touchdown order cannot be inferred from ordinary box scores and is labeled accordingly.

Data providers and affiliate disclosure

Odds and market prices are supplied through The Odds API. Player statistics are supplied through BALLDONTLIE. Bet This Guy is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any sportsbook unless explicitly stated.

If sportsbook referral links or paid partnerships are added, they will be labeled clearly next to the link. A paid relationship will not change the market data or the ranking methodology.

Responsible play

Set a limit, never chase losses, and treat betting as entertainment. If gambling is causing harm, call or text 1-800-GAMBLER or visit the National Problem Gambling Helpline.

Contact

Questions, corrections or privacy requests: email support@betthisguy.com. To stop pick emails, use the unsubscribe link in any email or the switch in your account.
